views.markdown:
Adds a heart button to the lock screen to like or unlike the currently playing Spotify track, without opening the app.

Works across three processes: SpringBoard draws the button, com.apple.MediaRemoteUI supplies its real position on iOS 17+, and Spotify itself handles the actual like/unlike action. State stays in sync between them in real time.

### 1.3
iOS 17 finally working, plus NextUp3 compatibility

### 1.2
Fixed heart fill state (finally)

### 1.1
Fixed heart state sync, unlike, and dynamic position

### 1.0
Initial release
